sharedStyle: Tactile handmade papercraft for a calm Montessori-inspired game for ages five to six. Layered cut cardstock, deckled paper edges, visible natural fibers, tiny handmade irregularities, warm shallow physical shadows, front-facing studio lighting, clear child-readable silhouettes. No vector-flat look, no glossy plastic, no 3D render, no emoji, no interface chrome, no watermark.
cutoutRule: For isolated assets, keep the complete subject centered with at least twelve percent breathing room on every side. Nothing may touch or cross the canvas edge. Use the requested uniform chroma plate outside and through every truly empty opening; do not cast a shadow onto the chroma background.

entries.prompt: Create a 4:3 papercraft color atelier environment plate. A large warm-cream handmade paper sheet with softly deckled edges must keep the central sixty-five percent calm and usable. Layer torn coral, saffron, teal, green, blue, and plum construction-paper corners around the outer perimeter. No objects, cards, controls, letters, or text. Preserve generous safe space in every corner for real game controls. Apply the shared papercraft style.

Create an isolated hand-cut paper title lockup spelling exactly ‘Color Gradient Cards’. Use chunky navy cardstock letters with cream cut-paper borders and a fan of small red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple paper shade cards behind the words. Every letter must be fully legible and correctly spelled. Center the complete lockup with broad padding. The edit must change only the outside background to a uniform vivid chroma green plate, preserving the title pixel-for-pixel.

Create a clean 2-by-2 sprite sheet of four matching circular papercraft game buttons for a premium preschool color-learning game. Solid uniform chroma-key green background (#00FF00), with absolutely no texture or shadow on the green backdrop. Each quadrant contains exactly one isolated button, fully visible, centered, same scale, and separated by very generous empty green gutters; nothing may touch a quadrant edge and no objects may overlap. Visual system: handmade layered cardstock and felt, warm cream outer deckled paper rim, muted coral-red stitched inner ring, tiny golden-yellow paper accent tabs, subtle real paper fibers, shallow tactile bevel from stacked paper, soft shadow contained close to the button. No plastic, no glass, no glossy highlight, no metallic shine, no 3D-rendered toy look. High-contrast deep navy cut-paper symbol, simple enough for ages 5–6. Quadrants, reading order: 1. top-left: bold left-pointing Back arrow. 2. top-right: simple speaker with exactly two curved sound waves. 3. bottom-left: simple house/home symbol. 4. bottom-right: bold right-pointing Play triangle. No words, no letters, no numbers, no extra icons, no confetti, no decorative scene. Orthographic front view. Consistent light from upper left. The exact entire silhouette of every circular button, including paper edge and close shadow, must fit comfortably and be visually centered in its quadrant with at least 18% padding on all sides.
